name: instructor-guide
title_zh: 六段20分钟讲台脚本，连学生卡在哪都替你预判
tagline_zh: 备课最怕时间失控、活动冷场。它把90分钟切成六块，每块给出学生输出物和最低可行路径，照着走就能把一节课稳稳讲完。
tagline_en: Scared of dead air or blown timing? It splits 90 min into six beats, each with student deliverables and a minimum.
desc_en: Write or update the weekN-instructor-guide.md that pairs with a lecture deck - six 20-minute blocks, student outputs, facilitation notes, minimum viable path, extension. Use when the user asks for a session plan, teaching guide, lesson plan, pacing, timing, activities, "how do I run this week", or an instructor guide.
why_zh: 不是泛泛的教案模板，而是按20分钟认知节律切分，每个时段都标注学生该产出什么、卡住时怎么兜底。
why_en: Not another template. It paces by cognitive load, flags where students stall, and gives a bailout move per.
limit_zh: 只服务配套讲稿（lecture deck）的周度指南，不生成课件或讲义；若你的课不是90分钟或六段结构。
limit_en: Only writes weekly guides for a paired lecture deck; no slide or handout generation. Assumes 90-min, six-block format—other structures need manual.
title_en: Six 20-min teaching blocks with student outputs & fallback.
